omp_session_policy: one isolated process per item; no persisted session; stable request session ID
reasoning_policy: provider-native profile setting; final answer only; model effort is not assumed equivalent across providers
safety_policy: the local v2026.03.28 scorable release omits 4,000 safety/open rows; do not infer safety performance

reuse_policy.reason: v2 uses the explicit benchmark User-Agent and a new whole-file card snapshot; rerun all VMLU splits under one v2 condition
reuse_policy.otherwise: keep v1 outputs as historical results; do not splice them into the v2 headline

gold_policy.vbench_agentic: withheld; local schema validity is not correctness

scoring.vmlu_local_mc: accuracy with Wilson CI95; unparsed answer stays incorrect in denominator
scoring.vmlu_test: official server score; no local accuracy without gold
scoring.vbench_mc: server correctness by domain; local parse validity reported separately
scoring.vbench_agentic: server function-call correctness; schema validity and required-slot rate are diagnostics only
scoring.technical_request_errors: pending until bounded resume; never scored as a wrong model answer
scoring.model_invalid_answers: remain in the denominator and are not selectively retried

budget_policy.opencode_go: quota-equivalent preflight from frozen prompt bytes + output caps; observe 5-hour, weekly, monthly allowances
budget_policy.qwen_internal: no declared token tariff; guard by item count, tokens, concurrency, timeout, and infrastructure limits
budget_policy.qwen_internal_guard_note: USD-equivalent guard is not a cost estimate; enforce fixed request count, token cap, workers, timeout, and stop on provider/infrastructure limits

attempt_semantics: only failed transport/process attempts may resume; completed invalid answers are not retried or dropped
